# Option reference

Option objects are immutable dataclasses with fields fixed at construction.
Unified `qdjj_solver.solve` and the Floquet entry points
also accept dictionaries; direct static backend solvers require their own option objects.
Energies and tolerances are in the units of the Hamiltonian. The descriptions are the field
docstrings in the source; [Using the solver and saving results](../interfaces.md) explains how to
choose the settings.

## QP solver

`qdjj_solver.qp_solver.SolverOptions` (source: `src/qdjj_solver/qp_solver/solver.py`)

| Option | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `method` | `str` | `"auto"` | Eigensolver: `"auto"`, `"dense"`, `"sparse"`, `"matrix-free"`, `"schur"` or `"block"`. `"auto"` diagonalizes densely up to dimension 128, uses sparse ARPACK up to 400,000 and matrix-free ARPACK above. `"block"` uses LOBPCG for several eigenstates, including degenerate multiplets. |
| `eigenpairs` | `int` | `1` | Number of lowest eigenstates computed in the selected sector. |
| `tolerance` | `float` | `1e-11` | Relative ARPACK eigenvalue tolerance, for the internally shifted operator H - sigma with sigma below the smallest diagonal element by an offset of order one; for `"schur"` the root-search tolerance in energy units. For `"block"`, the residual tolerance in energy units, capped at `residual_tolerance/10`. Unused by dense diagonalization. |
| `residual_tolerance` | `float` | `2e-9` | Largest accepted projected residual norm, in energy units. |
| `maxiter` | `int` | `10000` | Maximum number of ARPACK or block-LOBPCG iterations. |
| `ncv` | `int` | `40` | Requested Krylov-space dimension; increased as needed for the number of eigenstates and limited by the sector dimension. |
| `max_dimension` | `int` | `5_000_000` | Largest allowed number of Fock basis states, checked before the basis is enumerated. |
| `max_nnz` | `int` | `100_000_000` | Largest number of stored sparse-matrix entries (dense, sparse and Schur methods); the remaining `max_memory_gib` budget can lower it. |
| `max_memory_gib` | `float` | `24.` | Limit on the estimated basis and matrix storage, in GiB; the total memory use can be larger. |
| `threads` | `int` | `1` | Maximum number of threads used by the numerical libraries. |
| `seed` | `int` | `1729` | Seed of the random starting vector of the iterative eigensolvers. |

## DMRG solver

`qdjj_solver.dmrg_solver.SolverOptions` (source: `src/qdjj_solver/dmrg_solver/solver.py`)

| Option | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `eigenpairs` | `int` | `1` | Number of eigenstates to calculate, optimized sequentially. |
| `chi_max` | `int` | `128` | Maximum MPS bond dimension. |
| `max_sweeps` | `int` | `60` | Maximum number of sweeps per initial-state trial and eigenstate. |
| `min_sweeps` | `int` | `10` | Minimum number of sweeps per initial-state trial and eigenstate. |
| `energy_tolerance` | `float` | `1e-11` | Absolute energy tolerance, in energy units: TeNPy's sweep-to-sweep energy criterion and the stability test of the last sweep energies; the local Lanczos tolerance `E_tol` is derived from it. |
| `entropy_tolerance` | `float` | `1e-8` | Dimensionless entropy-change threshold of TeNPy's stopping test. |
| `residual_tolerance` | `float` | `1e-7` | Maximum accepted physical residual norm for convergence of the finite problem, in energy units. |
| `orthogonality_tolerance` | `float` | `1e-8` | Tolerance on deviations of the overlap matrix from the identity and on overlaps with earlier eigenstates. |
| `svd_min` | `float` | `1e-14` | Smallest retained singular value during optimization; may be zero. |
| `lanczos_maxiter` | `int` | `100` | Maximum number of local Lanczos iterations. |
| `seed_trials` | `int` | `4` | Number of initial-state trials per eigenstate, including randomized states. |
| `seed` | `int` | `1729` | Seed of the local random transformations of initial states. |
| `seed_randomization_steps` | `int` | `4` | Layers of local random unitary transformations for additional initial states; zero disables randomization. |
| `excitation_operator` | `str \| None` | `None` | Name of a model observable that conserves the sector's quantum numbers; its fluctuation applied to the previous eigenstate supplies the first trial state for the next eigenstate. |
| `mixer` | `bool` | `True` | Enable TeNPy's optimization mixer. |
| `mixer_amplitude` | `float` | `1e-5` | Initial mixer strength. |
| `mixer_sweeps` | `int` | `6` | Number of sweeps after which the mixer is switched off. |
| `group_size` | `int` | `2` | One or two canonical fermionic modes per MPS site. |
| `mode_order` | `tuple[int, ...] \| None` | `None` | Permutation of all zero-based canonical mode indices; `None` keeps the model order. |
| `observables` | `tuple[str, ...] \| None` | `None` | Observables to evaluate: `None` selects all named observables, a tuple selects specified names, and `()` selects none. |
| `calculate_residuals` | `bool` | `True` | Evaluate the residual norm of (H - E) psi for each state after optimization, without MPS compression. |
| `require_convergence` | `bool` | `False` | Raise an error when the finite-problem convergence checks fail. |
| `threads` | `int` | `1` | Maximum number of threads used by the numerical libraries. |
| `lanczos_probability_tolerance` | `float` | `1e-14` | Local Lanczos probability-error threshold, passed to TeNPy as `P_tol`. |

## Floquet calculations

`qdjj_solver.qp_solver.FloquetOptions` (source: `src/qdjj_solver/qp_solver/floquet.py`)

| Option | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `floquet_cutoff` | `int` | `4` | Floquet cutoff M: the Sambe matrix retains the harmonic blocks m = -M, ..., M. |
| `basis` | `str` | `"fock"` | `"fock"` uses the full QP Fock space of the sector, `"eigen"` the `basis_states` lowest static eigenstates. |
| `states` | `int` | `4` | Number of lowest static states tracked through the drive; they label the dressed states. |
| `basis_states` | `int` | `32` | Size K of the static eigenbasis for `basis="eigen"`; choose K at a gap of the static spectrum, retaining complete degenerate multiplets. |
| `selection` | `str` | `"tracked"` | `"tracked"` returns the continuations of the tracked static states, `"all"` every distinct Floquet state of the truncated Sambe matrix (dense solver or explicit `targets`). |
| `branch` | `str` | `"auto"` | Replica that defines the reported quasienergy: `"label"` continues the assigned static state, `"centroid"` is the replica whose harmonic centroid lies in [-1/2, 1/2); `"auto"` uses `"label"` for `selection="tracked"` and `"centroid"` for `selection="all"`. |
| `method` | `str` | `"auto"` | Sambe eigensolver: `"dense"`, `"shift-invert"` or `"auto"` (dense up to `dense_dimension`). |
| `dense_dimension` | `int` | `2000` | Largest dimension diagonalized densely: the Sambe matrix for `method="auto"`, the static solution and the propagator. |
| `targets` | `tuple[float, ...] \| None` | `None` | Explicit shift-invert target quasienergies; by default the static energies of the tracked states. |
| `eigenpairs_per_target` | `int` | `8` | Initial number of shift-invert eigenpairs per target; doubled for a target until its tracked state is assigned a distinct Floquet state with at least `tracking_threshold` weight. |
| `max_eigenpairs_per_target` | `int` | `64` | Upper limit on `eigenpairs_per_target` during successive doubling. |
| `target_shift` | `float` | `1e-7` | Offset added to the default shift-invert targets to separate them from the reference eigenvalues. |
| `tracking_threshold` | `float` | `.25` | Minimum time-averaged weight of a tracked static state in its assigned Floquet state. |
| `steps` | `int` | `256` | Number of time steps per period of the one-period propagator; doubled for the reported result when `step_check=True`. |
| `step_check` | `bool` | `True` | Repeat the propagation with twice as many steps and estimate the time-step error from the change of the quasienergies; the finer result is reported. |
| `step_tolerance` | `float \| None` | `None` | If set, raise an error when the estimated propagator step error exceeds it, in energy units; requires `step_check=True`. |
| `zone_center` | `float` | `0.` | Centre c of the zone [c - omega/2, c + omega/2) of the `folded` quasienergies. |
| `drop_scalar_harmonics` | `bool` | `False` | Remove the c-number parts of the harmonics H_k with k != 0; the quasienergies are unchanged, but the harmonic weights of the modes are redistributed. |
| `tolerance` | `float` | `1e-11` | Eigensolver tolerance of the static solution and of the shift-invert iterations. |
| `residual_tolerance` | `float` | `2e-9` | Largest accepted window residual of the Sambe and static solutions, in energy units. |
| `maxiter` | `int` | `10000` | Maximum number of iterations of the static and shift-invert eigensolvers. |
| `max_dimension` | `int` | `5_000_000` | Largest allowed Fock-basis and Sambe dimension. |
| `max_nnz` | `int` | `100_000_000` | Largest number of stored sparse-matrix entries. |
| `max_memory_gib` | `float` | `24.` | Limit on the estimated storage of dense Sambe matrices, sparse LU factors, propagators and probe images, in GiB. |
| `threads` | `int` | `1` | Maximum number of threads used by the numerical libraries. |
| `seed` | `int` | `1729` | Seed of the random starting vectors of the iterative eigensolvers. |
